description: Look up an issuer by ISIN code via GLEIF. Finds the legal entity that issued a security with the given ISIN using the GLEIF LEI registry. Returns the issuer's LEI card. If no entity is linked to the ISIN, returns 404. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
name: registry_isin
title: Look up an issuer by ISIN code via GLEIF
